race.comment: JUST DESSERTS (3) ran well on debut last start to finish third over 1400m at this track in a tougher race. He should come on plenty from that and any natural improvement will see him very hard to beat. LOLLIE'S GALORE (4) ran below expectations when fresh from a spell at Bendigo over 1300m last time, finishing sixth and beaten 4.5 lengths. Should improve and did show ability in two runs last campaign. AUBAINE (1) returned last time with a solid second at this track over 1400m. Fitter now and Shinn sticks out of a good form race, rates well. AURORA'S BELT (7) went forward and battled home into fourth over 1400m at this track last time. Tricky draw but has good early speed, can give a sight.
